questions.text: How much do you trust Federal Politicians?
How much do you trust State Politicians?
How much do you trust Political parties?
How much do you trust your local State MP?
How much do you trust your local Federal MP?
How much do you trust the news media in Australia?
How much do you trust social media?
How strongly do you agree or disagree with each of the statements listed below? Australia’s Federal political leaders have the capability to solve long term challenges
How strongly do you agree or disagree with each of the statements listed below? [STATE]’s political leaders have the capability to solve long term challenges
Australia’s Federal politicians understand and represent people like me
[STATE]'s politicians understand and represent people like me
People in government can usually be trusted to do the right thing
Federal politicians in Australia are honest (do what they say)
Federal politicians in Australia show empathy (understand and listen to people)
Federal politicians in Australia deliver (follow up and deliver on their commitments)
Federal politicians are courageous (stand up for what they believe in and are willing to take risks to achieve things)
Politicians in [State] are honest (do what they say)
Politicians in [State] show empathy (understand and listen to people)
Politicians in [State] deliver (follow up and deliver on their commitments)
Politicians in [State] are courageous (stand up for what they believe in and are willing to take risks to achieve things)
How effective or ineffective would you say Australia’s Federal government is?
How effective or ineffective would you say Australia’s [State/Territory] government is?
How much do you trust the Federal Government?
How much do you trust the [State] Government?
All things considered, how satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the way Australia is heading?

If a vested interest (e.g., business, union, lobby group) promoted a policy that benefited itself but could be harmful to society as a whole, how likely do you think it is that the Federal government would refuse that interest’s demand?
How confident are you that the Federal government adequately balances the interests of current and future generations?
How confident are you that the [STATE] government adequately balances the interests of current and future generations?
Do you think the following governments look internationally to find policy solutions? Federal Government
Do you think the following governments look internationally to find policy solutions? State Government

The [STATE] government is transparent enough in its decision making
The Federal government is generally clear about its priorities for what it is trying to achieve
The [STATE] government is generally clear about its priorities for what it is trying to achieve

The [STATE] government is focused on addressing the long-term challenges facing Australians

The [STATE] government reports clearly on progress towards its objectives

[STATE] politicians are able to work with members of other parties or Independent MPs on issues of national importance

How much do you trust Federal Parliament
How much do you trust State Parliament

How much do you trust the Federal public service?
How much do you trust the State public service?

Corruption is a problem in [STATE] politics
The Australian public service has the capability to solve long term challenges
The [STATE] public service has the capability to solve long term challenges
The public service can deliver major projects, programs, or services on time and on budget

Satisfaction with the health system in Australia
Satisfaction with public infrastructure (e.g., roads, public transport, parks) where you live
Satisfaction with the quality of administrative services in Australia (e.g., applying for an ID or benefits, registering a birth etc.)
Satisfaction with the level of safety in your local neighbourhood
Satisfaction with social security and support provided to those in need (e.g., welfare payments, public housing)
Satisfaction with your overall experiences with Australia’s public services
Satisfaction with your overall experiences with [STATE] public services
How effective or ineffective would you say independent government regulators and advisory bodies (e.g. ACCC, ASIC, Fair Work Commission, Infrastructure Australia) are?
How responsive were the government services you accessed?
How confident are you in navigating government services?

On a scale of 0-10 where 0 means not at all likely and 10 means very likely, if there was an innovative idea that could improve a public service, how likely do you think it is that it would be adopted by the responsible public institution in Australia?

On a scale of 0-10 where 0 means not at all likely and 10 means very likely, if there was an innovative idea that could improve a public service, how likely do you think it is that it would be adopted by the responsible public institution in [STATE]?

Satisfaction with the performance of the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC)

The [STATE ELECTORAL COMMISSION]’s ability to administer elections?

I consider our elections to be free and fair
I am confident I understand how Australia’s democracy works
The political system in Australia allows people like me to have a say in what the government does
I have access to quality information on policy issues I care about

People can freely express political opinions and ideas in Australia
It is sometimes justified to use extreme measures such as violence to advance a cause you care about
Political debate in Australia is healthy and respectful
Democracy is preferable to any other kind of government, even if those I disagree with are elected
